function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values (e.g., P014 appears twice), and `sample_seq` indicates that some patients were re-tested (sample_seq = 2 for some). The data dictionary says: 'The row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.'", "implication": "We must deduplicate the data on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Failure to do so would double-count re-tested patients, biasing any patient-level statistic. This changes the analysis plan: we must deduplicate BEFORE computing the fraction."}
function.name: note_finding
